releases.tagline: Major Release: Turbo Multi-Threaded Engine, Network Diagnostic CDN Latency, and Clean Architecture
whatsNew: Turbo Multi-Thread Engine: Akselerasi unduhan maksimal dengan 8 concurrent fragments, buffer size 64KB, dan HTTP chunk size 10MB.
Real-Time Network Diagnostics: Uji latensi ping TCP akurat ke CDN global (YouTube, Cloudflare, TikTok, Instagram, Google Global) dan estimasi throughput unduhan.
Auto Media Preview: Pratinjau instan thumbnail video, channel uploader, dan durasi otomatis saat link ditempel.
Contextual Resolution & Format Picker: Seleksi fleksibel Best Quality 4K/2K/1080p dan audio MP3 320k murni setelah URL diverifikasi.
Interactive Batch Playlist Downloader: Modal checklist interaktif untuk mengunduh seluruh playlist atau video pilihan.
Multi-Platform Build Targets: Kemasan otomatis installer MSI & portable ZIP (Windows), DMG (macOS), dan executable AppImage (Linux).
improvementsAndFixes: Zero-Window Silent Execution: Eksekusi proses yt-dlp.exe dan ffmpeg.exe 100% senyap di latar belakang menggunakan flag CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x08000000).
Clean Architecture & Resilient Git Index: Perlindungan index Git Windows NTFS dari tabrakan watcher dengan core.fscache false dan optimasi file excludes.
Type-Safe Diagnostics & Dev Simulation: Modul pengujian jaringan dan metadata media dilengkapi fallback simulasi untuk kemudahan pengembangan lokal.

commitLog.message: feat: rilis v2.0 major engine turbo download network test dan optimasi performa maksimal
commitLog.author: parikesitad-pm

releases.tagline: Auto Thumbnail Preview, Contextual Quality Picker, Playlist Downloader & Silent FFmpeg
whatsNew: Auto Media Preview: Pratinjau thumbnail, judul video, nama channel/uploader, dan durasi otomatis saat link ditempel (paste).
Contextual Quality Selector: Pilihan resolusi (4K Ultra HD, 2K, 1080p, audio MP3 320k) tampil rapi dan kontekstual setelah preview video muncul.
Interactive Playlist Picker: Modal pemilihan video playlist dengan fitur Select All / Deselect All dan tombol Download Batch.
Multi-Platform Release Targets: Dukungan kemasan otomatis ZIP untuk Windows, DMG untuk macOS, dan AppImage (langsung jalan tanpa install) untuk Linux.
improvementsAndFixes: Silent Background Process: Mengeliminasi kemunculan jendela konsol hitam ffmpeg.exe dan yt-dlp.exe di Windows dengan flag CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x08000000).
Universal Hash Fallback: Mengganti cmdlet Get-FileHash dengan algoritma SHA256 berbasis .NET runtime yang kompatibel 100% di semua versi PowerShell.
Optimal Watcher Config: Menambahkan pengecualian folder build di .vscode/settings.json untuk mencegah tabrakan file index Git di Windows NTFS.

releases.tagline: Official Release v1 with Tauri v2 Async Engine & Multi-Platform Pipeline
whatsNew: Modern Gemini-inspired Desktop UI with frosted glassmorphism & dual dynamic themes.
Full 4K Ultra HD (2160p) and 2K (1440p) direct downloading pipeline with zero quality loss.
Instant Audio-Only Studio Converter: MP3 (320kbps/192kbps), pristine M4A, and studio WAV.
TikTok No-Watermark high-speed scraper integration with instant CDN link resolver.
Instagram Reels, Carousels, and single video post downloader with automated session header spoofing.
WhatsApp Status Reader for local cache retrieval (Images, Videos, and Voice status).
Automated FFmpeg sidecar muxing for synchronizing high-bitrate separate video & audio streams.
improvementsAndFixes: Migrated core architecture to Tauri v2 Rust for negligible RAM footprint (~35MB idle).
Real-time streaming stdout regex parser with instant ETA, percentage, and MB/s download speed metrics.
Resolved YouTube signature deciphering delay on age-restricted and music videos.
Graceful handling and user-friendly toasts for rate-limiting (HTTP 429), private media, and disk space limits.
Added Git short commit hash build injection for total transparency across dev/production builds.
